name: failure texts follow the strategy wording

name: failure texts follow the strategy wording
claim: Under a strategy without wording neutral the shell and local tools fail with the texts they gave before aa62df3, and under strat-serial-3.0 with the neutral ones.

models.result: Checks written red: scripts/test-localbridge.mjs 173 pass, 8 fail (five older strategies x nine local failures byte for byte from the fixture; the shell's own message under three older strategies); scripts/smoke.mjs (main) 258 pass, 1 fail (a shell call the in-page machine cannot run, under an older strategy). name: provider retry
claim: A chat request that fails before any chunk with HTTP 502, 503, 504, 429 or a network error is asked again at the provider seam (2 more tries, 1 s then 3 s), so a transient provider error does not end the turn.

models.result: scripts/test-retry.mjs 26/26 (mock behaviour 'fail <status> x<n> [late]' plus the openrouter code path on a stand-in for fetch, no network): 502/503/504/429 and network errors before the first chunk retried; not retried after a chunk, on 400/401/404/500, or on abort (also during the wait); waits 1000 then 3000 ms, injectable; every attempt sends the same body; retries never in a request body. smoke (main) 245 pass: ledger row has retries 2 after 'fail 502 x2', no retries key on a plain row, a third 502 still fails the turn with retries 2 on its row. Not yet seen against a real OpenRouter 502; helper rows do not record retries.

name: stop line names how a run ended
claim: When wh say, sayfile or step returns because the run ended other than done, it prints one STOP line with the stop reason and what the page said, in text and in --json, so the operator does not read the last message to find out.

models.result: scripts/test-wh.mjs 32 pass 0 fail: 'STOP failed: HTTP 502: Provider returned error' and 'STOP limit: 8 tool rounds' (text and --json stop/stopDetail) for say, sayfile and step; no STOP line for done or for a request that healed on retry; the header's 'stop limit' is unchanged. The detail is the page's error notice, which is not persisted, so a stop seen after a page reload has a reason but no detail.

name: failed continuation is not steering
claim: The turn profile counts a short follow-up that continues a failed stop apart from steering, and reports calls before the first git commit made through the shell, so a session is not misread from tool names alone.

models.result: Recount from docs/concepts/profile-live1-2026-11-20.json (perTurn after/shortFollowUp): steering 3 -> 1, failedContinuations 2 (both 8-character 'continue' after a failed stop), limitContinuations 14 unchanged. Calls before first commit 54 of 145 (a 'git add ... && git commit' on the first line of a shell call), callsBeforeFirstWrite stays null. scripts/test-profile.mjs 34/34. wh log counts still call a continue after failed a steer.

name: harness-neutral wording
claim: Under strat-serial-3.0 no text the harness gives a model (core prompt, tool definitions, tool results, injected turns, helper prompts) contains an identifying term, so a model cannot tell from it what runs it; the strategies registered before it keep their original wording.

models.result: Checks pass: every request variant buildRequest makes, the helper prompts kept as module data, the watcher's and filter's prompts as sent, a whole session request with shell and local_* results, and the failure texts hold none of the 12 terms of app/neutral.js. Changed in place: descriptions of shell, concern_file, local_info, local_http, local_read; the not-configured answer of the local tools; the watcher's system line; one line of the scratch helper's prompt; shell and local tool failures now read plainly. Known residue: inside the in-page machine wh-install, WH_SHELF, ~/.wh and the placeholder token name are still there to be found by a command; the scratch helper's prompt names Alpine and wh-install; a model that reads app/tools.js can match its own tool list. Not measured: whether a real model can name what runs it.

2026-11-20: the in-place rewording (aa62df3) is undone for every registered strategy and becomes the data of strat-serial-3.0 (wording: neutral). strat-serial-1.0, checkpoint-1.0, stem-1.0 and stem-2.0 send the pre-aa62df3 tool definitions byte for byte; serial-2.0 differs from 1.0 only in output_read and repo_read; serial-3.0 differs from 2.0 only in shell, concern_file and local_*; the local tools answer, the watcher line and the scratch line follow the strategy. Residue: failure texts of the shell and local tools stay plain under every strategy; strat-serial-2.0 was registered in 8b7dca5, which does not contain aa62df3, so it first appeared on dev with the old wording and 160bd59 changed it in place (the judge defined 2.0 as 1.0 plus ranged reads).
